Build's clean now — exits 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when a flag was `undefined`, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled.

The rest — DEP warnings, dedupe notes, tree-shaking messages — is just noise from the version bump, not errors. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
